tools.name: GenerateApp
tools.description: AppCreator24 is an AI app builder and APK maker for Android. Creates Android apps and builds APKs, returning download and editor links. Also replaces the sections of an app previously created through this service. Supports up to six sections: webpages/PDFs, HTML content, quizzes, audio, video, user

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: GenerateApp · Public sink: GenerateApp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: GenerateApp · Public sink: GenerateApp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
